description: This file contains the implementation of the ManagementGrain class for Orleans, which manages silo operations such as retrieving host statuses, forcing garbage collection, collecting runtime statistics, and managing grain strategies. It defines methods for interacting with silos and grains, including control commands and statistics gathering.

classes.name: ManagementGrain
classes.description: Implementation of the Orleans management grain responsible for silo management, grain statistics, and control commands.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Retrieves the current silo host statuses, optionally only active silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedHosts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about silo hosts, optionally only active ones.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on specified silos.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Forces activation collection on specified silos.

methods.name: ForceRuntimeStatisticsCollection
methods.description: Triggers runtime statistics collection on specified silos.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics from specified silos.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves simple grain statistics from specified silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves detailed grain statistics, optionally filtered by types and hosts.

methods.name: GetGrainActivationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of activations for a specific grain reference.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for grains.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy for grains.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy (overload)
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for a specific grain interface type.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy (overload)
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy for a specific grain interface type.

methods.name: GetTotalActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of grain activations across silos.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a grain provider.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the activation address for a given grain reference.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Gets the list of active grains of a specific type.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Retrieves grain call frequency data across silos.

methods.name: ResetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Resets grain call frequency counters across silos.
